evidence.quote: We estimate our fees for the work in Clause 1 at GBP 45,000 excluding VAT and disbursements

items.question: What must the tenant have paid for the lease break to take effect?
items.answer:
The tenant must have paid all rent due up to the date of the lease break. This is specified in the break clause, which states that the Tenant may end the Lease on 31 March 2030 by giving six months' prior written notice, provided that the Tenant has paid all rent due up to that date [1].

There is no indication in the documents that any additional payment other than the rent is required for the lease break to take effect.

evidence.quote: The Tenant may end this Lease on 31 March 2030 by giving the Landlord at least six (6) months' prior written notice, provided that the Tenant has paid all rent due up to that date.

items.question: Which schedule of the MSA describes the Services?
items.answer:
The MSA's Schedule 1 describes the Services. According to the definitions in the MSA, "Services" means the Harrowgate platform subscription and related support described in Schedule 1 [2: "Services" means the Harrowgate platform subscription and related support described in Schedule 1].

Clause 3.1 of the MSA also references Schedule 2 for the service levels, but the specific description of the Services is found in Schedule 1 [1].

evidence.quote: Provider shall provide the Services in accordance with the service levels in Schedule 2.

items.question: Where is the address for notices under the MSA set out?
items.answer:
The address for notices under the MSA is set out in Schedule 4 of the agreement. The relevant clause states: "Any notice under this Agreement shall be in writing and addressed to the General Counsel of the receiving party at the address set out in Schedule 4" [1].

No other address is provided in the sources for notices under the MSA.

evidence.quote: Any notice under this Agreement shall be in writing and addressed to the General Counsel of the receiving party at the address set out in Schedule 4

items.question: Who will provide the Services after the acquisition of Harrowgate completes?
items.answer:
The documents indicate that Harrowgate will continue to provide the Services after the acquisition completes. The Change of Control notice states, "Harrowgate will continue to provide the Services under the Agreement on its existing terms after completion" [1].

No other entity is mentioned as taking over the provision of the Services. The documents do not specify any change in the provider of the Services following the acquisition.

evidence.quote: Harrowgate will continue to provide the Services under the Agreement on its existing terms after completion

items.question: What does Kestrel store for Voss-Lindqvist?
items.answer:
Kestrel stores Voss-Lindqvist's archived equipment at its Brookfield facility [1].

The monthly storage fee for Voss-Lindqvist is EUR 4,600, as amended in the agreement [7]. This change took effect on 1 June 2026 [8].

The original agreement stated a monthly fee of EUR 4,000, but this was replaced by the amendment [1][7].

evidence.quote: Provider will store Client's archived equipment at its Brookfield facility.
Client shall pay a monthly storage fee of EUR 4,600, invoiced on the first business day of each month.
evidence.document_title: Amendment No. 1 to the Kestrel storage agreement

evidence.quote: This Amendment takes effect on 1 June 2026.
evidence.document_title: Amendment No. 1 to the Kestrel storage agreement

evidence.quote: Client shall pay a monthly storage fee of EUR 4,000, invoiced on the first business day of each month.

items.question: On what date did the Hall 3 chiller fail?
items.answer:
The documents do not state the date when the Hall 3 chiller failed.

The witness statement mentions that the temperature alarm sounded at about 02:40 on 18 June 2026 [1]. However, it does not explicitly state that the chiller failed on that date.

The documents in this matter do not answer that.

evidence.quote: I recall that the temperature alarm sounded at about 02:40 on 18 June 2026.

items.question: When did Voss-Lindqvist accept the Calder & Wynne engagement letter?
items.answer: The documents indicate that Voss-Lindqvist accepted the Calder & Wynne engagement letter on 7 February 2026. This is stated in the engagement letter itself, which notes: "*Accepted for Voss-Lindqvist AB by Petra Voss on 7 February 2026 (fictional).*" [2]

evidence.quote: Accepted for Voss-Lindqvist AB by Petra Voss on 7 February 2026 (fictional).

items.question: What must Harrowgate maintain to protect information under the MSA?
items.answer: The documents state that Harrowgate must maintain an information-security programme no less protective than ISO/IEC 27001 to protect information under the MSA [3].

evidence.quote: Provider shall maintain an information-security programme no less protective than ISO/IEC 27001

items.question: Whose consent does the tenant need to assign the whole warehouse lease?
items.answer:
The tenant needs the Landlord's consent to assign the whole warehouse lease. The relevant clause states, "The Tenant may assign the whole of the Premises with the Landlord's prior written consent, which shall not be unreasonably withheld" [1].

No other consent is mentioned in the sources provided.

evidence.quote: The Tenant may assign the whole of the Premises with the Landlord's prior written consent, which shall not be unreasonably withheld
